implementation: code/signal-trace/pipeline/overlap/counterexample_replay.py (prepare, and the reading of the row that writes the sign), with fed_replay.py's capture and record; run by run.sh in this folder
hypothesis: The project's hypothesis: a capability leaves a recurring difference between the traces of correct and wrong answers, and editing the weights where that recurring difference lives repairs the capability. What this run tests is one reading of that difference at one row. The fitting wrong answers subtract the descent's energy at the first sign after KE_i. On the two lines six of them write word for word ('Potential Energy gained ...' then 'Kinetic Energy at bottom of descent (KE_{bottom}): KE_i') the recorded matrix inputs of those six and of the four correct fitting answers on the same two lines part at that row from layers 7 to 12 on (records/development/2026-11-12-path-forward/same-text-sign). But the six all have the initial kinetic energy above the descent's energy and the four all have it below, and over the 36 recorded answers on those two lines the sign goes with that: a minus in 6 of 6 above, a plus in 27 of 30 below (sign-by-regime). So the recurring difference on record at that row is the sign and the question's numbers together. The account this run tests: the part of that difference that appears first (layers 12 to 19) follows the numbers, and the part that comes later (layers 20 to 34) follows the sign the model is about to write. Three recorded answers write the minus with the kinetic energy below on those same two lines; they are the rows that can speak against either half.
why_this_direction: Step 3 asks for the discrepancy along the whole path with what recurs kept, and Marcos's direction is that the trace defines the divergence, not the token (journal/2026-11-10-controlled-training.md). The objective's owner settled on November 12 that the trace-derived request comes first and that a sign's site needs the sign contrast evidence (04e855aa, 5c12dc14). That evidence, read this evening from files, removed the support I had claimed for the sign's row: a key built from the wrong sign rows answers on the same-text correct answers as on the wrong ones (sign-rows), and the same-text contrast is two regimes of the numbers (sign-by-regime, same-text-sign). A request built from the fitting same-line difference would therefore ask the wrong rows for the other regime's computation along with the other sign, and nothing on disk can say how much of the difference is which: every recorded trace at that row has sign and regime together. The twelve answers named here are every recorded answer outside the registered sixty that breaks that tie in either direction; their tokens are on record and their traces are not. The owner admitted them in the auxiliary role (47249c20). It is the next step because the request's site at this row cannot be reasoned further from what is kept, and it decides no site by itself.
repeating_pattern_check: Four things have happened more than once. (1) A difference between the fitting groups was taken for the capability's difference and was something else that went with it: the label's route (withdrawn November 12), the Total line against the Kin line (my sign-row claim, withdrawn this evening on Astra's correction), and now the numbers' regime. Each time the groups differed in something written before the row. This run reads rows chosen to break exactly that tie, and its reading is fixed here before any of them is read. (2) Readings were made on cases chosen by how they came out. The twelve follow from a rule over every labeled recorded answer (prepare checks the rule gives these twelve and no others), none chosen by its trace. (3) A recording made on one card was treated as the model's answer on another. Measured for this declaration from cases on record: of the thirty fitting answers, the own answer on card 1 is the registered recording's text in 21 and is that text through the row that writes the sign in 27; in the 17 fitting questions kept by fed-continuations-replay-original when this was written, no step of an own answer has the screening recording's score hash (0 of 17 answers), and where the text is the same the greatest change of a best token's score is 0.07 to 0.16 logits. So this run does not call a replay the model's own answer: per case the record says where card 1's own first choice is not the recorded token, and the sign's row is read with card 1's own scores of the two signs beside it. (4) A declared replay was refused by the recorder for a reason not checked before declaring (twice in fed-continuations-replay-original); this run uses the case form that run ended with, which has read 24 questions on this card.
what_went_wrong_before: Every construction so far repaired some answers and broke others. On the evening of November 12 I told both seats that a change keyed at the sign's row could leave the correct answers alone; the correct answers it left alone were the ones on another line, and the four on the same text answered the key at 0.91 to 1.24 of the request. The fitting thirty hold no row at which the sign differs with the text and the regime the same, so no reading of them could have shown it.
rule: Data roles, as the owner set them: deliberately selected diagnostic counterexamples; auxiliary original-model observations only. No case joins the frozen reference, the cohort, the fitting folds or any score; none is a target support; nothing here makes a target, a mask or a threshold, solves a weight or reads an edited model. No answer is generated: every token of every recorded text but its last is supplied and the model writes the last one itself, as in fed-continuations-replay-original's second revision. A departure of card 1's own first choice from a recorded token is recorded with the scores and is not repaired: no retry, no changed feed. The comparisons are counterexamples to a simple account of regime, sign or wording and isolate none of them: the numbers and the earlier text of a case and of the fitting answers beside it differ. Gaps are listed, not covered: no recorded answer writes a plus above the descent's energy on the six's two lines. The answers no fit uses are not read (the sibling of expanded-047-h1 is one and is named by its id only); reserved-40b is not opened; the original model file is read only. expanded-071-h3 is also a member of the cohort of 45 (cohort-original); this run reads the screening recording of it, changes no membership, and records that the cohort's recording holds the same 514 tokens with no step's scores equal to the bit. Deviations, stated, the same as fed-continuations-replay-original's: card 1 instead of GPU0, the card the fitting own answers beside these cases were read on, so nothing here is compared with a GPU0 state; the recorder's raw stream of one question at a time is a temporary outside this folder, removed once kept/ holds it losslessly with every state checked bit for bit against it; the selection is read from this seat's committed development records (cases_built_from), frozen in cases/ with their sha256.

cases.derivation: Two rules over every labeled recorded answer, checked by prepare to give these twelve and no others. (a) On the two lines six wrong fitting answers write ('Potential Energy gained' before; '... Energy at bottom of descent (KE_{bottom}): KE_i' to the sign), the initial kinetic energy not above the descent's energy, the sign a minus: 3 of the 30 answers below on those lines (expanded-060-h3, expanded-061-h1, expanded-062-h1; none registered). (b) A 'Kin' line, the kinetic energy above the descent's, the sign a plus, not a fitting answer: 9 (the tenth such answer on record is the fitting answer expanded-071-h1). 12 cases, 12 questions, 8,498 positions (cases/index.json); every text ended by itself.
cases.scales_with: The labeled recorded answers and the two lines the fitting wrong answers write.

fitting_answers_read_beside_a_case.derivation: A fitting answer is read beside a case when it writes the case's two lines (or, listed apart as looser, the same line before with another line to the sign), from its own answer on card 1 kept by fed-continuations-replay-original, at the row that writes its own sign, and only where that own answer is the registered text through that row (27 of the 30; of the six on the first pair of lines, five: expanded-068-h1 departs at step 69 and is listed, not read). Beside the three: five that write the minus (above) and four that write the plus (below). Beside the two under 'Height dropped': two that write the plus (one above, one below) and none that writes the minus. Beside the seven under 'KE_{B, before} = KE_A': one that writes the plus (below) on the same two lines, and looser two that write the minus (above) on 'KE_B = KE_A'.
fitting_answers_read_beside_a_case.scales_with: The fitting answers, their wording and the card they are read on.

layer_bands_of_the_reading.derivation: From the six against the four at the feed-forward inputs, by how many of the ten rows fall nearer their own group's mean when left out of it: the first layer at which all ten do is 12, and the first layer from which all ten do at every later feed-forward input is 20. Bands: layers 0 to 11 (36 merges), 12 to 19 (24 merges), 20 to 34 (45 merges). No other number enters the reading: t is a projection onto the line between two group means, and 'nearer' compares two distances.
layer_bands_of_the_reading.scales_with: The fitting answers on the two lines and the model's depth; three merges a layer.

what_is_kept_per_position.derivation: As derived there: of the 247 tensors a position has in the raw stream, the scaled embedding and the 105 added parts are kept (106, and the output norm at each step) after every sum and layer exit is checked bit for bit. No case shares positions with another, so all 8,498 positions are kept: 5.19 GiB; the largest raw stream of one question is 1.2 GiB.
what_is_kept_per_position.scales_with: The recorder's retention scope, the model's depth and width, and the answers' lengths.

disk_margin.derivation: The machine's disk rule as that runner applies it: 40 GiB stay free beside what a command writes. Capture is not started unless 5.19 GiB kept, 1.2 GiB raw of one question and 40 GiB fit (47 GiB), and checks again before each question.
disk_margin.scales_with: The disk's size and the owner's rule.

prediction: Four statements, each counted by the record command. (1) No step of any of the twelve has the source recording's scores to the bit: the screening recordings are another card's (0 of 17 fitting own answers kept so far have one such step). (2) Card 1's own first choice at the step that writes the sign is the recorded sign in expanded-060-h3 and in the nine (the sign led by 1.27 logits or more in their recordings, and between the cards a best token's score moved by at most 0.16 where the text stayed the same). For expanded-061-h1 and expanded-062-h1 (0.19 and 0.27) nothing is predicted; whichever sign card 1 prefers is recorded and the row is read under it. Whole-text reproduction is not predicted: 9 of the 30 fitting own answers are another text on card 1. (3) The three beside the five and the four, at the state each merge puts out at the row that writes the sign: at the merges of layers 12 to 19 more of them lie nearer the plus answers' mean than the minus answers' (the three share the plus answers' regime), and at the merges of layers 20 to 34 more lie nearer the minus answers' mean (they write the minus), for each of the three whose own first choice on card 1 is the minus. At layers 0 to 11 nothing is predicted: the groups themselves do not part there. (4) The two under 'Height dropped' (plus, above) lie no farther from the mean of the two fitting plus answers of that wording than those two lie from each other, at the merges of layers 20 to 34. The seven under 'KE_{B, before} = KE_A' are described, not predicted: they have one fitting answer on their two lines.
would_weaken_it: (1) A step with the source's scores to the bit would mean the cards agree after all; the comparison with GPU0 states would then be open. (2) If card 1 prefers the plus in expanded-060-h3, or the minus in one of the nine, the case is no counterexample on this card and is read as what card 1 prefers. (3) Against the account: the three nearer the minus answers already at layers 12 to 19 (the early difference is then the sign's own path and the regime was what went with it, so the fitting same-line difference is nearer a usable sign request than this declaration assumes); or the three nearer the plus answers at layers 20 to 34 (the same-text difference at this row is then the numbers through the last layer and holds no part that follows the sign, so no request for the sign can be built from it). Either outcome is information about where the recurring difference lives; neither supports or weakens the project's hypothesis by itself, because three answers at 8 J below, two of them near ties, are not a sample. (4) If the 'Height dropped' answers above the descent's energy lie far from the fitting plus answers of their wording, the wording does not carry the computation the plus goes with, and the regime shows in the trace even where the sign does not follow it.
